# SoundStack

> Curated deal radar for music producers: daily audio plugin sales, free synth presets, and boutique soundware.

SoundStack keeps a short list of real vendor pages. A listing includes a price only when that price was read from the vendor page. Unlisted prices are omitted rather than guessed.

## Key pages

- [Deal radar](/): Search and category filters for the current list
- [About](/about): How a listing is chosen and when a price is shown
- [Feature a plugin or pack](/sponsor): $149 sponsorship checkout via Stripe Payment Link
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Pages Next.js publishes for crawlers
- [Robots](/robots.txt): Crawl rules, including common assistant crawlers

## Categories

- VST Plugins
- Free Synth Presets (Serum, Vital, and Diva)
- Underground Sample Packs

## Data

Listings live in `data/deals.json` as a JSON array. A daily script can append an object with the same fields. See the README for the schema.
